utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Larchfield Plumbing, this is Oisin.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Hi Oisin, Sam from Vantrellis. Okay, let's get started.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Today I'll walk you through how we work and then show you the product.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Most teams we talk to struggle with time tracking, so let me show you how we fix that.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Is that costing you much?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Some, I'd guess. Hard to say.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: What would success look like by the end of the quarter?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Get time tracking down to a two hour month end, and zero missed timesheets.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Our platform helps teams like yours schedule faster and keep everyone updated. It has mobile alerts, reporting, and integrations with the tools you already use.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Right, and the thing that worries me is whether my

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Right, right, so that's exactly what our dispatch module handles.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay. What does something like that cost?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: It's eighteen thousand dollars a year.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: That's steep for us.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: I hear you. I could probably do fifteen percent off if that helps.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Maybe. I'd have to think about it.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Who else weighs in on a decision like this, and how have you bought software like this before?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: I'd bring in Robin, our CFO. Robin signs anything over ten thousand. Last time it took about a month with a trial first.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: So a trial, then Robin, about a month. Is there a date you'd want this live by?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Before the busy season, so November.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Does what you've seen so far make sense for your team?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Can you just send me some info and I'll look it over?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Sure, I'll send over our deck and a case study.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: I'll send over some info and you can let me know what you think.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Thanks Oisin, really appreciate the time.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Thanks, bye.

tone_windows.note: Rep does most of the talking in this stretch.
